copy:
Barry spent decades believing he was “just the big, strong, chunky guy.”
That this was his role in life.
That getting truly lean just wasn’t in the cards.
Until he discovered what was actually possible at 65.
40 lbs down.
Energy through the roof.
Confidence back.
And finally seeing the version of himself he never thought existed.
If you’ve ever felt stuck in an identity that’s holding you back…
this clip is your sign that nothing about you is fixed.
You can watch the full episode by searching for The Fit Executive Show wherever you get your podcasts.

I’ve helped over 3,600 busy executives get lean without living in the gym.
And after coaching that many executives over 40, I’m here to tell you that training harder and counting your macros is NOT going to cut it anymore.
The truth is, you HAVE to work with your hormones if you want to get the most out of your training.
ESPECIALLY after 40.
Because testosterone levels in men have dropped by about half over the last 50 years, and they keep falling every year after 40.
That means your workouts are less effective…
It takes way longer to burn enough calories to see any real fat loss…
And even beyond how you LOOK… you probably feel like crap too.
That’s exactly why I created the Metabolic Metric System.
It’s a 90-day plan that helps high-performers in their 40s, 50s, and 60s get lean, strong, and fit by customizing their training and nutrition around their hormones.
And as a 42 year old myself, it’s also the same protocol I use to stay in elite shape all year round.
So if you’re an executive over 40, and you’re feeling sluggish, can’t get rid of the spare tire around your waist…
And you want someone to help you hit the easy button to get lean, strong, and fit in the next 90 days, here’s how my team can help:
First, we do a comprehensive blood panel that measures your blood sugar, hormones, inflammation, gut health and more…
so we know exactly where to start.
Second, once we have your bloodwork results, we build a custom training and nutrition protocol around your bloodwork and hormones.
We’ll build your workouts around your anatomy, your schedule, and how well your body recovers.
Then, we’ll adjust your nutrition based on the foods you like, the way you prefer to eat, and what your bloodwork tells us about things like blood sugar, hormones, and energy.
We’ll also help you maximize the results of sleep and recovery even if you’re not getting as much sleep as you should.
And all of this allows you to get lean & build strength while feeling sharp, focused, and energized again.
And finally, we hold weekly check-ins with you and your coach so you stay on track and make adjustments to your protocol as needed depending on what your progress tells us.
And the best part is, if you don’t get results, you don’t pay.
This system has worked so well for people like:
Michael, a 55-year-old vice president who lost 45 pounds…
And Barry, who lost 31 pounds in 90 days at 65 years old.

And over 3,600 others just like you.
